+++ b/tests/test_normalized_name_completion.py
@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+import click
+
+
+def normalize(value):
+    return value.casefold().replace("_", "-")
+
+
+def values(items):
+    return [item.value for item in items]
+
+
+def test_option_prefixes_and_source_filtering():
+    command = click.Command(
+        "cli",
+        params=[
+            click.Option(["--dry_run/--no_dry_run"]),
+            click.Option(["--tag_name"], multiple=True),
+            click.Option(["--hidden_name"], hidden=True),
+        ],
+    )
+    ctx = command.make_context(
+        "cli", ["--dry_run", "--tag_name", "x"],
+        token_normalize_func=normalize, resilient_parsing=True,
+    )
+    assert values(command.shell_complete(ctx, "--TAG-")) == ["--tag_name"]
+    assert values(command.shell_complete(ctx, "--NO-")) == []
+    assert values(command.shell_complete(ctx, "--HIDDEN-")) == []
+    fresh = command.make_context(
+        "cli", [], token_normalize_func=normalize, resilient_parsing=True,
+    )
+    assert values(command.shell_complete(fresh, "--NO-")) == ["--no_dry_run"]
+    assert values(command.shell_complete(fresh, "--DRY-")) == ["--dry_run"]
+
+
+def test_groups_preserve_original_names_and_distinct_matches():
+    group = click.Group("cli", commands=[
+        click.Command("Load_Data"), click.Command("load-data"),
+        click.Command("Load_Secret", hidden=True),
+    ])
+    ctx = click.Context(group, token_normalize_func=normalize)
+    assert values(group.shell_complete(ctx, "LOAD-")) == ["Load_Data", "load-data"]
+    plain = click.Context(group)
+    assert values(group.shell_complete(plain, "LOAD-")) == []
+
+
+def test_chained_siblings_use_their_owning_context_normalizer():
+    child = click.Command("child")
+    group = click.Group("cli", chain=True, commands=[
+        child, click.Command("Build_Task"), click.Command("Build_Secret", hidden=True),
+    ])
+    parent = click.Context(group, token_normalize_func=normalize)
+    ctx = click.Context(child, parent=parent, token_normalize_func=lambda s: s)
+    assert values(child.shell_complete(ctx, "BUILD-")) == ["Build_Task"]
+
+
+def test_parameter_custom_completions_are_not_prefix_filtered():
+    option = click.Option(["--value"], shell_complete=lambda c, p, i: ["Unrelated"])
+    command = click.Command("cli", params=[option])
+    ctx = click.Context(command, token_normalize_func=normalize)
+    assert values(option.shell_complete(ctx, "LOAD-")) == ["Unrelated"]

spec.question: Make option-name and command-name shell completion honor Context.token_normalize_func. For prefix matching, normalize both the candidate spelling and the incomplete string using the context that owns that candidate. Return the original spelling, not the normalized spelling, and preserve candidate order and distinct spellings even when normalization makes them equal. This must cover a command's option aliases, a group's own subcommands, and sibling commands offered through chained ancestor groups; an ancestor's candidates must use that ancestor's normalizer rather than the child's. When no normalizer is configured, behavior must remain unchanged. Preserve existing exclusions for hidden candidates, consumed non-repeatable options, and chained command availability, along with existing help metadata. Do not apply this new prefix filtering to Parameter.shell_complete results supplied by a custom callback or parameter type. Deliver a unified diff against production files only.
